mappings.title: "We are worthy to win." Goalkeeper Wolf about the game at Dynamo Makhachkala
mappings.summary_detail: Dynamo Makhachkala goalkeeper David Volk told RIA Novosti that the team is worthy of defeating any opponent.On Tuesday, Dynamo Makhachkala beat Spartak in Moscow in the third round of the group stage of the Russian RPL Cup, interrupting the series of "red and white" in six matches, taking into account all tournaments. Hamid Agalarov scored the only goal from the penalty spot (14th minute)."Of course, the whole team is glad that we won, and to this is added the fact that we were able to play for zero. The whole team fought to the last. It's great that I was able to help too. There are no easy opponents, the championship is strong enough, it's not easy with everyone, but it doesn't matter, we are preparing for any team," said Volk."Probably, there is no strong difference between the First League and the RPL to be noted. But there is definitely a higher speed here and the speed of decision-making is also higher. These points define the differences. The responsibility is always maximum, we go out for any match seriously minded and do not share a passing match or not. Our goal now is to gain a foothold in the Premier League. We deserve to perform here, we deserve to play and beat any opponent," he added.

mappings.title: The "Race of Inventions" shift took place at the A101 Leisure summer camp
mappings.summary_detail: The "Race of Inventions" shift took place at the A101 Lernity summer city camp in Moscow, where children were able to learn how to invent and work with their hands, as well as develop communication skills, the press service of the A101 development company reported. ""We carry out such week-long camp shifts during every school vacation. The guys are divided into several teams, each of which implements its own engineering projects. But if during the previous shifts the teams conducted one large development for all five days, then this week every day brought a new project. Therefore, the current shift was called the "Race of Inventions", � said Elena Bulin�Sokolova, head of the educational bureau "A101 Lernity".The tasks for each team were different, and the children successfully completed all of them. At the end of the shift, the guys showed their developments to their parents and told them about their implementation, the press service added.A101 is one of the largest developers in the capital, specializing in housing construction in New Moscow, and also works in the Leningrad region. The group's portfolio of current projects is about 2.1 million square meters.

mappings.title: 27 thousand tickets were sold for the Moscow Mayor's Cup hockey matches
mappings.summary_detail: About 27 thousand tickets have been sold for the Moscow Mayor's Cup matches, which already exceeds the figures of previous years, head of the Moscow Hockey Federation Andrey Nikolishin said at a press conference before the start of the tournament.The Moscow Mayor's Cup will be held from August 29 to September 1 on the ice of the Megasport Arena. Spartak, Dynamo and CSKA Moscow, as well as Vityaz near Moscow, and for the first time Yekaterinburg Avtomobilist and Nizhny Novgorod Torpedo will take part in the competition."Due to the events that are taking place here, clubs start pre-season training later, the Mayor's Cup is our most representative tournament, the last one before the start of the KHL. I am happy to welcome the teams that did not participate in our competition, I hope that they will compete - Torpedo and Avtomobilist. We are always glad to have strong teams. The formula has not changed, three teams in a group, each will play two games, then the semifinals and finals. The teams are looking forward to the start of the tournament. There is a lot of interest in the tournament, 27 thousand tickets have been sold, this already exceeds the figures of previous years," Nikolishin told reporters.

mappings.title: Two traffic police officers were detained in Moscow on suspicion of taking a bribe
mappings.summary_detail: Two traffic police officers in the Central Administrative District of Moscow were detained in the capital, they are suspected of taking bribes, the press service of the regional headquarters of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation told RIA Novosti."Two traffic police officers of the Department of Internal Affairs of the Central Administrative District have been detained, who are suspected of receiving illegal monetary remuneration from a citizen for not bringing him to administrative responsibility for traffic violations," the department said.As specified in the press service, the detainees have already been suspended from official duties. If their guilt is confirmed, they will be dismissed from the internal affairs bodies and will be punished in accordance with the procedure established by law, and their leaders will be brought to disciplinary responsibility, the Interior Ministry concluded.

mappings.title: Sonoma County man who tortured, abused adoptive children sentenced to life in prison
mappings.summary_detail: A Sonoma County man who tortured his three adoptive children for years while collecting state adoption assistance benefits was sentenced Tuesday to life in prison without the possibility of parole, according to the Sonoma County District Attorney�s Office.Jose Centeno, 57, of Rohnert Park was found guilty by a July jury of three counts of kidnapping for financial gain, three counts of torture and nine counts involving the sexual abuse of a child. He was sentenced Tuesday to six consecutive sentences of life in prison without the possibility of parole, three consecutive life sentences, and an additional 39 years in the California Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation.In 2006, Jose and Gina Centeno adopted three siblings ages 2, 3 and 4 years old and enrolled them at John Reed Elementary School. In 2010, after a school staff member filed a report to Child Protective Services on suspicion of physical abuse, the Centenos pulled the children out of school and hid them in captivity.The Centenos told neighbors and extended family that the children had been given back to the state and were not living in their home. In reality, the Centenos confined the three children in an upstairs bedroom with a boarded-up window and chained them to their beds. At one point, the oldest sibling, Kaya, lost consciousness from the abuse. Her siblings were told that Kaya had been sent away, and they never saw or heard from her again. For years, one of the remaining siblings was not allowed to leave the upstairs bedroom except when Jose Centeno would take her to another room and sexually abuse her. In late 2018 or early 2019, Jose Centeno took the two younger siblings to live with family members in Mexico.All the while, the Centenos told state officials that the children were still in their care and received hundreds of dollars each month through the Adoption Assistance Program. They collected these benefits until their crimes were discovered in 2020.After the two younger siblings told people in Mexico about their abuse, Mexico CPS in July 2020 alerted Sonoma County CPS, kicking off a criminal investigation.Jose and Gina Centeno were arrested in August 2020. Gina Centeno was charged as well but died before the trial commenced. Sonoma County Superior Court Judge Troye Shaffer sentenced Jose Centeno to the maximum potential sentence for his charges. The oldest sibling, Kaya, still has not been found. Based on witness statements, she is believed to have disappeared in 2012, when she was 10 years old. �While appropriate that Mr. Centeno will be spending the rest of his life in prison, our two brave victims are still missing their sister Kaya,� said District Attorney Carla Rodriguez. �Though justice has absolutely been served in this case, Kaya will always be in our thoughts.�Anyone with information on Kaya�s whereabouts is asked to contact the Rohnert Park Department of Public Safety at 707-584-2630. Her missing person page can be found on the website of the National Center for Missing & Exploited Children.

mappings.title: Free naloxone vending machines added in Marin County
mappings.summary_detail: Vending machines that dispense free naloxone, a nasal spray that can reverse the effects of opioid overdoses, have been installed throughout Marin County, public health officials announced Tuesday. The installation comes ahead of International Overdose Awareness Day on Saturday, and it�s part of the county�s effort to reduce opioid overdoses, the county�s leading cause of death in residents 55 and under, according to a news release. Marin County now has eight naloxone vending machines and three Naloxboxes, wall-mounted boxes containing naloxone doses, according to an interactive map of naloxone distribution sites available online.�We�re excited to expand the availability of naloxone throughout the county,� said Dr. Todd Schirmer, director of behavioral health and recovery services for the county of Marin. �The new interactive map on the OD Free Marin website allows everyone to do their part by locating and carrying naloxone so they can be prepared for emergencies.�Though naloxone is available for purchase over the counter or by prescription, the new vending machines are an effort to expand access to people without insurance or who cannot afford the medication, officials said.�Vending machines are a great way to make sure everyone has access to Narcan in a no-questions asked, cost-free and equitable way,� said Dr. Matt Willis, Marin County public health officer, referring to a brand name for naloxone.OD Free Marin, a community-based overdose prevention coalition, will teach residents how to use naloxone to save a life at a Saturday event.Other Bay Area counties have also worked to make naloxone more available. San Mateo County officials in May installed a naloxone vending machine in the lobby of Redwood City�s Maguire Correctional Facility.According to the California Department of Public Health, people who use drugs, people who take high-dose opioid medications prescribed by a doctor, and the family and friends of people at risk of opioid overdoses should carry naloxone on their person and at home.

mappings.title: Six illegal migrants were found in the Moscow martial arts club "Ermak"
mappings.summary_detail: Six illegal migrants were identified during searches in the capital's Ermak martial arts club, according to the Telegram channel of the IC of Russia in Moscow."As part of the criminal investigation into the organization of an extremist community (Article 282.2 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation) information was received about a violation of migration legislation at the Ermak martial arts sports club located on Taganskaya Street in Moscow," the message says.It is noted that as a result of searches in the club, 21 foreign citizens were identified. They were checked for compliance with migration legislation, as well as possible commission of other offenses in the capital region. "Six foreign citizens have been identified who violate the migration legislation of the Russian Federation. Protocols on administrative offenses under Article 18.8 of the Administrative Code of the Russian Federation have been drawn up against them," the message says.

mappings.title: The housing inspection revealed an illegal change in the appearance of a house in the east of Moscow
mappings.summary_detail: The Moscow Housing Inspectorate revealed illegal extensions in front of the entrances to non-residential premises in a house in the Moscow district of Kosino-Ukhtomskoye.According to the press service of the department, residents of the house on Lukhmanovskaya Street addressed the State Housing Inspectorate on the issue of illegal changes to the facade of the house. Housing inspectors have revealed the illegal installation of two external vestibules in front of the existing entrance groups to non-residential premises on the ground floor.�"The Moscow Housing Inspectorate has brought the owners of real estate to administrative responsibility and obliged them to bring the entrance groups to non-residential premises in accordance with the technical documentation," the message says.

mappings.title: A teenager died after inhaling an unknown substance from a balloon in Moscow
mappings.summary_detail: The teenager died after inhaling an unknown substance from a balloon in the courtyard on Volgogradsky Prospekt in Moscow, the Telegram channel of the Moscow prosecutor's office reported."According to preliminary information, a 15-year-old teenager, being near one of the houses on Volgogradsky Prospekt, inhaled an unknown substance from a red balloon," the message says.The department noted that the child was immediately hospitalized, he died on the same day.Kuzminskaya interdistrict prosecutor's office controls the establishment of all causes and circumstances of the incident.

mappings.title: Moscow is actively improving the investment climate in the city
mappings.summary_detail: Investments in fixed assets of the capital reached 6.8 trillion rubles last year, which is 3.8% more in comparable prices than in 2022, said the deputy head of the Department of Investment and Industrial Policy of the city Vladimir Petrakov.The statement was made at the session "Best Practices in Attracting Investments to BRICS Municipalities and Regions" at the VI International BRICS Municipal Forum in the capital at the Expocentre Central Exhibition Complex on August 27. "Investments in Moscow's fixed assets in 2023 reached 6.8 trillion rubles. At the same time, the share of the capital in the volume of investments in fixed assets of the Russian Federation increased by 1.7 times from 2016 to 2023. Moscow actively attracts business to the implementation of infrastructure projects and implements a comprehensive system of measures of financial and non-financial support for investors. Among them are concession agreements, offset contracts, localization of production in the special economic zone, preferential investment loans, creation of high�quality investment infrastructure and much more," the press service of the Diplomatic Mission quotes Petrakov.He noted that with the help of active work on the formation of a favorable investment climate, Moscow occupies the top lines of the national investment attractiveness ratings every year.The capital has a successful experience in implementing large-scale public-private partnership projects. Thus, in September 2023, Bagration Avenue was opened as part of the largest concession agreement in Moscow in terms of scale and cost. About 68 billion rubles were invested in the implementation of the project. Thanks to this, more than 1.5 million residents of Moscow and the Moscow region have improved transport services. Offset contracts are also an effective form of partnership between government and business. Under the terms of the offset agreement, the business invests its own funds in the creation or modernization of production facilities for the production of products necessary for the city, and the capital undertakes obligations to purchase these products for many years.Thus, since 2017, the capital has signed 22 offset contracts in medicine, transport, microelectronics, and the food industry. The total purchase volume will amount to about 413 billion rubles. More than 7 thousand jobs will be created at new production facilities. Investors have already completed the creation of production facilities and started supplying goods under eight such contracts.In addition, the capital scales successful practices and concludes intersubject offset contracts. So, in 2024, Moscow concluded three interregional offset agreements: with the Republic of Karelia, Orenburg and Vladimir regions. Under the contracts, enterprises will be created to produce products necessary for landscaping and road construction.The city also provides investors with land for the construction of production facilities without bidding at a preferential rate of one ruble per year as part of large-scale investment projects (MaIP), and the use of the "green corridor" will help speed up administrative procedures and halve the construction period of industrial facilities. At the moment, more than 80 MAIPS are being performed in Moscow. The total volume of investments in the creation of production facilities is estimated at 282 billion rubles. The Technopolis Moscow special economic zone has become a platform for high-tech high-tech industries. At the moment, it includes six sites, which represents more than 280 hectares of territory, over 1.2 million square meters of industrial space and more than 19.3 thousand jobs. In addition, there are more than 200 enterprises operating in the SEZ, where more than 100 have resident status. The volume of their investments in the city's economy exceeded 160 billion rubles over the entire period of their activity.In 2020, the Moscow Investor electronic service was launched to organize seamless communication between investors and industrialists with the government of the capital, so that entrepreneurs can send proposals to the authorities to develop their investment potential and improve the investment climate of the city. In addition, it is possible to solve problematic issues. Investors have used the service more than five thousand times since its launch.The capital is a developed industrial center of Russia, where they actively introduce innovations, as well as expand production facilities and develop technological capabilities. There are over 4.2 thousand industrial sites in Moscow, where 725 thousand people work.

mappings.title: The Metlakh tile, the secret room and the ghosts of the past: What the ancient mansions of the capital hide
mappings.summary: Mayor Sergei Sobyanin spoke about the restoration of Moscow's cultural heritage
mappings.summary_detail: - Preserving the history of the city is an important part of the work of the Moscow government. Since 2011, we have been conducting it continuously and during this time we have already restored more than 2,000 monuments, including manors, temples, fountains, metro stations," Sergei Sobyanin said. - This year, about 50 cultural heritage sites have been restored to their original appearance, 150 more monuments are in line, work on which we plan to complete by the end of the year. In total, specialists are currently working on 500 objects.And here are just some of them.The earliest mention of these lands dates back to 1504. It is believed that their first owner was Fedor Voronets, from whom the Vorontsov boyar family descended.At various times, the territory belonged to the Grand Duke of Moscow Ivan III, then Ivan the Terrible, and under Tsar Alexei Mikhailovich they were given to Prince Boris Repin, with him and his descendants, a manor, outbuildings, a French park, etc. appeared.In 1812, the estate was rented by the former Moscow leader of the nobility Nikolai Obreskov in order to ... build a balloon here that could lift 50 people into the air at the same time. It was planned to be used at the Battle of Borodino, but something went wrong, and the work had to be curtailed.In Soviet times, there was a state farm on these lands, during the Great Patriotic War there was a line of defense of Moscow. This area became a park area only in the 80s. It is clear that its restoration is a long, painstaking and very expensive task.- We started the restoration of the Vorontsovo estate in 2019, - says the mayor of Moscow. - The southern service building, the eastern and western wings, two historical pillars at the entrance were put in order. The gate and the entrance bridge have been adapted for modern use. The rafters were put in order in the Gatehouses, dormer windows were replaced, facades of brick and white stone were cleared, doorways and white stone plinths were restored. A souvenir shop and an excursion service point will open there soon.The wooden mansion was built on a stone foundation, which remained from the building after the fire of 1812. The first owner was Baron Vladimir Shteingel, a participant in the Patriotic War of 1812, a Freemason who joined the Decembrists. Secret meetings were held in his house. Perhaps that's why they equipped a secret room behind the closet. It was accidentally found in the 70s of the twentieth century by restorers: they took hold of a beautiful mirrored door, and suddenly it went aside, opening a room decorated with decayed velvet with Masonic signs. According to rumors, the house also had a secret underground passage, but little is known about it.In the 70s of the XIX century, the family of the famous philosopher and psychologist Lev Lopatin settled here. His mansion attracted the most prominent people of that time: Leo Tolstoy, Ivan Bunin, Fyodor Tyutchev, Alexander Ostrovsky, Konstantin Stanislavsky and many others were happy to come to them on "Lopatinsky Wednesdays".After the revolution, the rooms became communal apartments, they were resettled only by the 70s. Today, the Department of Architecture of the Russian Academy of Arts is located here.The three-storey house was built in the XVIII century, it changed many owners. Among them were the parents of the future poet Fyodor Tyutchev.The building was damaged in a fire in 1812 and was sold to the city authorities. So the Myasnitskaya police station settled here, to which the fire department joined in 1825. Dmitry Kuvshinnikov, a doctor, lived at the police station with his wife, the artist Sofia. They opened their own literary and art salon, which was attended by Anton Chekhov and the artist Isaac Levitan. After the revolution, a police station was located here, and in the 30s - the Military Engineering Academy of the Red Army. Now it is the administrative building of the Higher School of Economics.The mansion was rebuilt many times, so reconstruction was not an easy task.:- Restorers replaced the building's utilities and restored the facade. Based on historical photographs, they replaced the street metal doors with wooden paneled ones, and plastic double-glazed windows with more authentic wooden windows," Sergei Sobyanin said. - Later partitions were dismantled inside, the pre-revolutionary parquet was restored. During the work, a small area with Metlakh floor tiles was found in the basement, presumably at the end of the XIX century. It was cleared and reassembled.ONLY NUMBERs50 monuments have been restored since the beginning of the yearWork on 150 buildings is planned to be completed by the end of 2024500 monuments are currently in operation

mappings.title: Liksutov: Reconstruction is being completed at the Krasnaya Presnya depot of the Ring Line
mappings.summary_detail: Maxim Liksutov, Deputy Mayor of Moscow for Transport, said that the reconstruction of the Krasnaya Presnya depot of the Ring Line has reached the finish line. He recalled that since 1954, the repair and maintenance of subway cars on a full cycle has been carried out here. The large-scale reconstruction of this historical complex lasted several years. At the same time, the Krasnaya Presnya depot in the Moscow metro is the first in which a complete replacement of tracks was carried out."In 2021, in one of the oldest depots in Moscow, Krasnaya Presnya, we completely replaced the trains with Moscow 2020. At the same time, large-scale reconstruction work has begun," the deputy mayor noted.This includes replacing all tracks, updating facades and fences, and various engineering systems."On behalf of Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin, we are updating not only the passenger infrastructure, but also the electric depots that are engaged in the maintenance and operation of metro trains," Liksutov stressed.Among the main works performed at the Krasnaya Presnya depot are:- replacement of 3.8 kilometers of rails with new and more wear-resistant ones and 3.3 kilometers of contact rail;- installation of 50 new switches with modern design and extended service life;- laying 7 thousand reinforced concrete sleepers instead of wooden ones;- installation of 11 new lighting masts instead of the previous two. Thanks to this, the paths are now well lit even at night.In addition, all bathrooms and changing rooms have been completely renovated. At the expense of the city budget, a new depot fence was installed and the facade of the depot was put in order. It was also decorated with new evening lighting. In addition, the drainage system has also been updated.

mappings.title: A Muscovite bought souvenir coins from scammers for 500 thousand rubles
mappings.summary: The attackers convinced that they had found the treasure during the repair work in the temple
mappings.summary_detail: A resident of Moscow bought 202 allegedly antique coins from scammers. They turned out to be souvenirs, for which the man paid 500 thousand rubles, the prosecutor's office of the capital said.The 33-year-old accused, along with an accomplice, approached a passerby on Volgogradsky Prospekt and reported that during the repair of one of the churches in Sergiev Posad, ancient coins were found. The accomplices noted that they found themselves in a difficult situation and they urgently need money. Together with the potential victim, the scammers went to a pawnshop, where one of the coins was valued at 42 thousand rubles.The latter convinced the man and he bought the "treasure" for 500 thousand rubles, borrowing money.The only real value was the coin, which was valued at a pawnshop. The rest had no historical value and were souvenirs worth no more than 60 thousand rubles. The deception was revealed when a Muscovite tried to sell coins.The intruders were caught. The criminal case against one of the two accomplices has already been transferred to the court, in relation to the second it has been allocated to a separate proceeding.

mappings.title: A hotel in the style of Hagrid's hut from "Harry Potter" appeared in the Moscow region.
mappings.summary: The reporter found out from the creator of the project how she embodied the fairy tale in real life
mappings.summary_detail: A themed hotel has recently opened in the Moscow region, which fans of the Harry Potter universe will definitely appreciate. The Network began to discuss a small house in Kashira, which is built in the style of the hut of the forester of Hogwarts � Hagrid. Something similar has already been created in the UK, the birthplace of the writer J. K. Rowling. And now the house has appeared in Russia.Correspondent MSK1.RU I went there and talked to the creator of the hotel.Hagrid's Hut itself (The Keeper's Hut) is located on a 15-acre plot about a 20-minute drive from Kashira station, far from country houses. When you drive up to it, it's hard not to notice the hut � it seems to be in the forest, behind the trees.Just outside the entrance to the courtyard there is a pointer to various places from the movies � arrows in the direction of Hogwarts, the Ministry of Magic, the hut itself, King's Cross Station, the Forbidden Forest, Diagon Alley, Hogsmeade and even Azkaban.The creator of the hotel, Daria Rahimi, invites me inside the house. She says that initially, when she and her husband Arsalan were going to build an ordinary house for rent here, she did not think that she would make a hotel for Harry Potter fans. The idea to create a hut did not come immediately: at first, Dasha became interested in a new hobby and began to assemble constructors based on "Harry Potter", and then her husband proposed to build a themed hotel.� My husband and I built the house at the end of 2023, and in February of this year we started renting it out. We did everything ourselves, because he is an architect-builder by education, I am a business manager, and also an amateur decorator," she says.The courtyard of the hotel now looks a little empty, so it is also planned to be filled. For example, put a bath tub for bathing in the yard and greenhouses.� It also needs to be equipped thematically, so that people can come and transplant a flower into a pot with a Mandrake written on it, some kind of appendage to remember themselves by, - said Daria.And there are many people who want to visit the hotel. There are practically no free dates for arrival until November, but New Year's are still free. You can book a hotel for two days or more � sometimes an exception is made and I book only for one. But, according to the creator of the hotel, guests often do not have enough time to enjoy a fairy tale.The cost of a night at the hotel is 12.5 thousand rubles on weekdays and 15.5 on weekends. On New Year's Eve, you will have to pay 50 thousand rubles per night.

mappings.title: A mysterious slab with Old Slavic writings was found in Moscow. We explain what it is
mappings.summary_detail: Vadim Matyushin found an unusual stone on the territory of the former Chaika pioneer camp in the Krasnopakhorskoye settlement near Troitsk. He managed to find this piece of granite slab during landscaping work.� We went down to the shore to take measurements. And I saw this fragment with the image of a little man. He was sticking out of the ground by several centimeters, apparently, because of the rains, the ground was washed away. It feels like it's about a quarter of the plate. And there is an inscription on it in Old Slavonic about the god Svarog, who came down and then entered his house," Vadim said.According to the man, they handed over the stone to the customer of landscaping in this area and the management is now looking for archaeologists who could explain where this stone came from on the territory of the former camp.Historian Mark Nuzhdin, in a conversation with a reporter, doubted that this find could be valuable and relate to ancient times.� Although the font of the inscription is stylized as runes, but judge for yourself, why write about Svarog in Cyrillic? It is not easy to make out the inscription, but it seems that there is not enough "yate" � the preposition "y", for example, � said the historian.
